mapper.select: SELECT fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as prodid, to_char(ftr.vdate, 'yyyyMMdd') as startdate, to_char(ftr.mdate, 'yyyyMMdd') as enddate FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, fin_trade_product ftr WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = ftr.FINPROD_ID AND to_char(ftr.vdate, 'yyyyMMdd') < '${sysDate}' AND to_char(ftr.mdate, 'yyyyMMdd') >= '${sysDate}' AND fin.FINPROD_ID = '${prodId}'
